title: Hanna
body: Veldig lett å bruke. Fin app for å følge opp forskjellige aktiviteter du vil gjøre hver dag!
author: Hannab-b

title: Almost perfect
body:
This is by far the best app among the double digit number of apps doing this job. Its simple, has good and useful widgets, is customizable. The only "issue" i can find is that it is just a bit too hard to check the length of streaks.

Heres how i would do it. Add a streak number to each object on the "specific day" tab maybe move the text towards the middle with a number on the left and the completed/uncompleted hitbox beeing moved to the left. Then make clicking on an object take you to the page where you can edit goals and currrently check streaks.
author: eddi180
